# Step-by-step verification of OLS regression

x = [1990, 1991, 1992, 1993]
y = [35912852, 40757150, 45666452, 50222460]
n = 4

print("=== OLS Step by Step ===")
print(f"x: {x}")
print(f"y: {y}")

# xbar, ybar
xbar = sum(x)/n
ybar = sum(y)/n
print(f"\nxbar = {xbar}")
print(f"ybar = {ybar}")

# deviations
x_dev = [xi - xbar for xi in x]
y_dev = [yi - ybar for yi in y]
print(f"\nx deviations: {x_dev}")
print(f"y deviations: {y_dev}")

# cross-products
cross = [dx * dy for dx, dy in zip(x_dev, y_dev)]
print(f"cross-products: {cross}")
numerator = sum(cross)
print(f"sum of cross-products = {numerator}")

# x squared deviations
x_sq = [dx**2 for dx in x_dev]
print(f"\nx^2 deviations: {x_sq}")
denominator = sum(x_sq)
print(f"sum of x^2 deviations = {denominator}")

slope = numerator / denominator
intercept = ybar - slope * xbar
print(f"\nslope = {slope}")
print(f"intercept = {intercept}")

# FY1995 prediction
x_pred = 1995
y_pred = slope * x_pred + intercept
y_avg = y_pred / 12
print(f"\nFY1995 predicted sum = {y_pred}")
print(f"FY1995 average (÷12) = {y_avg}")
print(f"Round to nearest whole number = {round(y_avg)}")
